mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) above 1100 and 100 index points, respectively, indicates robust consumer and business demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1100 and INDPRO > 100, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO < 100, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly change in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the CPI index exceeds 2.5% (as measured by CPIAUCSL), it signals accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 245.0, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market characterized by rising employment (PAYEMS > 145000) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0) signals potential wage inflation, which typically leads to central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 145000 and UNRATE < 4.0, or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.5% signals aggressive central bank policy that reduces liquidity and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
